cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a training simulator bay — holds her keepsake at chest height; a quiet observatory planetarium foyer with a circular bench — she offers the better half of her oversized sesame bun toward the viewer; a rooftop surf-wave practice basin under a peach evening sky — she has just climbed out after an enthusiastic practice run and laughs while carrying her lightweight training board back to the rail; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — holds a cup in both hands; a sunny ranch — standing; an outdoor pool with lounge chairs and clear blue water — sitting on the ground; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — sitting on the ground; an ice palace hall of carved crystal pillars — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — standing; inside a general's command tent — shakes a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by her ear to hear how much wine is left; a convention photo zone under ring lights — raises a camera to her eye to take a photo; a roller rink under coloured lights — kneeling on the ground; a Three Kingdoms film-set street — standing
